facts.value: ASU provides in-house credential evaluations of your academic coursework at no extra cost.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: ASU will accept course-by-course evaluations from the following agencies: Educational Credential Evaluators, Foreign Credentials Service of America, Academic Credentials Evaluation Institute, Scholaro.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: Official evaluations do not take the place of submitting official academic records. The evaluation is in addition to the official academic record.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA

facts.value: If the evaluation agency includes academic records they used to complete their evaluation and indicates that the evaluation was based on official or authenticated records, ASU may accept those documents as official.
facts.programme_association: Social and Cultural Analysis (American Studies) - BA
